name: FUNKYKOPS
tagline: Clavs, electric pianos, bass, brass, strings and talkbox: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: Funk, disco and G-Funk keys, bass, brass and talkbox
gumroad_title: FUNKYKOPS - Funk & Disco Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Clav, Rhodes, Talkbox
summary: A funk, disco and G-Funk synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (clavinet, Rhodes-style electric piano, synth bass, brass, strings, lead, guitar and talkbox) and 70 factory presets.
about: FUNKYKOPS, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character knobs (VOWEL, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
47 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode for chords, up to 16 voices at once; the 23 bass, lead and FX presets that suit single-note lines load in Mono mode.
Built for Funk, Disco, G-Funk, Hip-Hop and Afrobeat productions.

features.d: Clavinet, Rhodes, synth bass, brass, strings, lead, guitar and talkbox.
VOWEL, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from wah clavs to string pads and talkbox leads.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated envelope.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 36 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: FUNKYKOPS plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The Save button writes a .fkpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
